title: Sorceress by Eclipse Lake
description: A woman in a flowing blue and pink robe stands on a stone ledge overlooking a reflective lake, holding an open book and reaching toward floating magical books and cherry blossom petals. An eclipse shines in the twilight sky above, with its reflection in the water, while an open book and crystal orb rest on the ledge nearby.
prompt: A woman with long brown hair wearing a flowing dark blue robe with pink and gold accents stands on an ancient stone ledge beside a calm lake, holding an open book in one hand while reaching toward glowing floating books and cherry blossom petals swirling around her, an eclipse with a glowing corona in the purple twilight sky above with its perfect reflection in the water, magical mist and fireflies in the air, more open books growing from cherry blossom trees in the background, an open book and crystal orb with flowers on the ledge in the foreground, ethereal fantasy atmosphere, detailed digital painting
